Fuel

Add Fuel to your Home Screen

This page opened inside Overload. Fuel keeps its own data, so it has to be added from Safari.

  1. Tap Open in Safari below.
  2. Tap Share in Safari's toolbar.
  3. Choose Add to Home Screen.
  4. Open Fuel from its new icon.
Open in Safari

If the button does nothing: copy the link, open Safari and paste it there.

https://example.github.io/overload/fuel/
